# Flushout

> Flushout is a Python developer tool for privately relaying stdout and stderr to an authenticated web browser in real time. Flushout servers do not save streamed output; the receiving browser retains its device-local copy for up to 24 hours.

## Primary links

- Website: https://flushout.online/
- Python package: https://pypi.org/project/flushout/
- Source code: https://github.com/souvikm99/flushout
- Production release: https://github.com/souvikm99/flushout/releases/latest

## Install

`pip install flushout`

## Basic use

```python
import flushout

with flushout.stream(name="training-run"):
    print("Hello from anywhere")
```

Interactive runs ask for the user's Flushout portal username and streaming password before output capture begins. The live URL is private to the authenticated account. Optional completion emails contain bounded success or failure metadata, never stdout, stderr, or tracebacks.

## Privacy boundary

Flushout relays live output through Cloudflare. The application does not intentionally persist streamed output in its database, server object storage, analytics, logs, or backups. The receiving browser keeps received output in local storage for up to 24 hours, and the output travels through Cloudflare's network, so users should not stream secrets or regulated data.
